assets.hydrationAuthority: Pinned ElizaWy/LPC GitHub commit first when core assets are missing; manifest-verified local/remembered mirrors are fallback only.

authoredContent.chunkOverlay: editor overlay only, default 32x32; no neighboring chunk materialization yet
authoredContent.structuralEditing: explicit SceneV2 structural cell transaction; provisional PIE override only
authoredContent.editorShell: permanent compact left tool rail + permanent compact layer rail; all feature-rich tool applications are floating/dock-over-canvas windows; docking never reserves/reflows the world canvas
authoredContent.toolLauncher: bottom-left Havenwild launcher expands right/up over canvas; Ctrl+Space; only real wired applications enabled; planned World Generator/Pixel/Animation entries remain disabled until implemented
authoredContent.commandRegistry: src/editor_commands.rs central labels/descriptions/shortcuts shared by rail/toolbar/tooltips; direct canvas tools Q/B/E/P; Save Ctrl+S; Undo/Redo Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y; PIE F6; Focus F11
authoredContent.collisionEditing: Source artwork stays immutable. Collision is Havenwild metadata with reusable exact-source profiles and optional local 32x32 per-cell pixel masks; direct click-drag painting on the World canvas supports 1/2/4/8px brushes and 16x cursor-anchored zoom.
authoredContent.collisionPrecedence: Local world collision override > reusable exact-source behavior profile > semantic traversal default. Removing an override reveals the inherited profile/default; no ElizaWy PNG bytes are modified.
authoredContent.assetAuthority: One canonical ElizaWy lane under content/assets/authority; original source pixels immutable; runtime/world composition references exact canonical source regions; generated artwork forbidden.
authoredContent.worldComposition: Local .forgepy/world/havenwild_world.local.json; signed 32x32 chunks; source-driven Summer semantic terrain, reusable source behavior profiles, local terrain/traversal/collision/elevation overrides, and generation tombstones persist through regeneration.
authoredContent.worldGenerator: Single shared Summer semantic resolver consumes exact ElizaWy source geometry recovered from mature Havenwild Native mapping; generated river does not force MudBank; Grass/Water, Dirt/Water, and Grass/Dirt are independent semantic relationships; generated artwork and pixel-color runtime guessing are forbidden.
authoredContent.worldPanels: World Properties, World Generator, Terrain Rules, Scene/Layers and specialist panels use compact dockable surfaces with collapsible sub-sections; advanced evidence/DG controls are hidden behind explicit advanced sections so normal authoring remains canvas-first.

sourceControl.dirtyPolicy: never_stash_reset_rebase_or_overwrite; skip refresh and build local worktree
sourceControl.bootstrapPolicy: Full Gate may precede Git setup; primary workflow option 2 can initialize/adopt the canonical GitHub origin while preserving the certified source tree.

pcc.failurePolicy: child failures are captured; interactive host remains open; debug bundle auto-generated
pcc.assetBoundary: source-only; hydrated art is excluded from patches/packages/debug bundles
pcc.telemetry: phased full gate with unique phase receipts, exact-version governed patch chaining, Windows-safe patch identity checks, post-apply hashes, Cargo-free Rust source/module/dependency audit, authored-scene source-rect validation, Summer mapping recovery validation, 16-mask semantic resolver-lab validation, full resolved semantic-to-recipe edge/corner + bit-orientation pipeline validation, early complete-manifest preflight + immediate full core-asset identity certification, Cargo.lock snapshot + --locked metadata verification, per-job heartbeat, active-job recovery, gate receipts, recent-log diagnostics; runtime-generation handshake prevents pre-update PCC processes from certifying post-update source
pcc.gitPublish: Full Gate records both Git state and a Git-history-independent publishable-source fingerprint. Primary option 2 can bootstrap Git or attach the canonical shifty81/HavenwildBevy origin after certification without invalidating the gate when source bytes are unchanged. Existing unrelated remote history is adopted with git reset --mixed so current source files are preserved, then certified changes are committed onto origin/main. Machine-readable Git filename queries keep stderr separate so Windows core.autocrlf warnings cannot become staged path names. Fetch/ahead-behind checks still fail closed on behind/diverged branches, forbidden local payloads, or post-gate source edits.
pcc.mainWorkflow: 1 Full Quality Gate / certify current source; 2 Commit + Push certified source to canonical GitHub (self-heals missing local Git/origin and safely adopts existing history); 3 Patch scan/review/apply; secondary operations remain grouped by function.

terrain.fixtureCoverage: 16/16 topology masks covered by checked-in fixtures and the immutable semantic resolver seed; editor experiments persist separately under .forgepy
terrain.mapper: Normal authoring is semantic/canvas-first. Terrain Rules summarizes 305/305 Summer runtime cells, 41 source groups, 81/81 G/D/W corner states, fill variation and source-backed water animation. Advanced source evidence/manual DG tools remain collapsible and optional.
terrain.confidencePolicy: certified/reviewed/source_mapped/candidate/ambiguous/unsupported/unmapped; historical evidence never auto-promotes to certification
terrain.resolver: One shared source-driven Summer resolver in AssetAuthority/WorldDocument drives generator, authored world paint and runtime preview; homogeneous fills use deterministic exact-source variants, tri-material junctions use exact-source quadrant composites, and homogeneous RiverWater can cycle source-backed Summer phases. Historical generated-atlas rules and pixel-color classifiers remain diagnostic only.
terrain.consolidationPolicy: historical source/address only; no auto semantic promotion or recipe certification
